# Task 24 environment: Copilot LLM phrasing (all optional)

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED` | `false` | `1/true/yes/on` turns it on. Off = rule-based, no outbound call. |
| `COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL` | empty | OpenAI-compatible base including `/v1`; we POST `<base>/chat/completions`. Redirects are not followed. |
| `COPILOT_LLM_MODEL` | empty | Model id sent to the provider (also the only model name logged). |
| `COPILOT_LLM_API_KEY` / `_FILE` | none | Bearer key, read with `read_secret`. |
| `COPILOT_LLM_TIMEOUT_S` | `10` | Total wait (0.1-120). Bad value = default. |
| `COPILOT_LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | `400` | 16-4000. Bad value = default. |

Enabled without a base URL or model: rule-based answer plus warning `llm_unavailable`, `limits.provider_configured=false`.
Warnings: `llm_unavailable` (provider trouble), `llm_rejected` (the answer failed validation). Logs: model id, provider request id, outcome word; never a prompt, answer or key.
No new dependency (`requests` is already in `requirements.txt`).
